definitions.explanation: The opposite side from the front; the hidden or less visible side of something.
The hidden aspects or background of a situation; what goes on out of public view.

examples.japanese: {紙|かみ}の{裏側|うらがわ}に{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write your name on the back of the paper.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{裏側|うらがわ}に{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}がある。
examples.english: There's a parking lot behind the building.

examples.japanese: この{事件|じけん}の{裏側|うらがわ}には{複雑|ふくざつ}な{事情|じじょう}がある。
examples.english: There are complicated circumstances behind this incident.

notes:
{裏側|うらがわ} combines {裏|うら} (back, reverse) + {側|がわ} (side).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～の{裏側|うらがわ}に (on the back side of ~)
- {裏側|うらがわ}を{見|み}る (to see the reverse side)

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {表側|おもてがわ} (front side) - antonym
- {右側|みぎがわ} (right side)
- {左側|ひだりがわ} (left side)
- {向|む}こう{側|がわ} (the other side)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {裏側|うらがわ}: back side, reverse
- {裏|うら}: back (simpler form)
- {背面|はいめん}: back surface (more formal/technical)
